This report compares the known number of natural satellites (moons) orbiting the planets Jupiter, Saturn, and Mars, based on available astronomical data.

| Planet | Moon Count | Notes |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Jupiter** | 115 | This count is based on data available as of April 2026. |
| **Saturn** | 95 | This count is derived from available planetary fact sheet data. |

***

*Disclaimer: Moon counts for gas giants like Jupiter and Saturn are constantly updated as new moons are discovered, so these figures are subject to change.*
